name: Ounce · Swiss Assay
business: Ounce — concept app to buy allocated physical gold from €10, stored in Zürich. Premium Spanish version of the Ounce site. Fictional brand, illustrative figures.
goal: Waitlist signups (email) before the app opens.
kpi: Emails submitted in the «Apúntate a la lista» form.
style: Swiss Assay — limestone, steel ruler, exact measures by day; dark concrete vault at the end. Newsreader + Archivo
sections: film: 120 Blender Cycles frames tied to scroll, gold cubes from 10 € (1.7 mm) to a 1 kg bar along a steel ruler, then the camera dives into the gold
app: HTML phone UI, three steps change the screen
caveau: 60 Cycles frames walking a concrete corridor to the bar, waitlist form on the scene
stack: Binario A: static HTML/CSS/JS, GSAP 3.15 + ScrollTrigger, Lenis 1.3, frame sequences on canvas 2D
